esp32-nut-ecoflow — firmware installer

Connect an ESP32-S3 board over USB, then:

Works in Chrome, Edge, or Opera on desktop (Web Serial). The installer erases the flash and writes esp32-nut-ecoflow-factory.bin at offset 0x0.

After flashing

  1. The device creates an open Wi-Fi network ecoflow-setup-XXXX.
  2. Join it — the setup page opens automatically (or browse to http://192.168.4.1/).
  3. Scan for your EcoFlow unit, pick your Wi-Fi, and save.
  4. Point your NUT clients at the device's LAN IP, port 3493.
